# Model policy

Goal: the quality bar every gate demands, at the lowest cost that meets it.
Every agent declares a **role**; the role fixes its **tier**; the tier fixes
model and effort. Model IDs live in one place, the framework's `tiers.json`.

## Tiers

| Tier | Model | Effort | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan` | claude-opus-5-5 | high | Planning and orchestration: one run steers many downstream runs, so a bad plan is the costliest error. Runs rarely, few tokens. |
| `judge` | claude-opus-5-5 | high | Quality gates: a false PASS ships a defect that is expensive to find later. Reads, never writes. |
| `author` | claude-sonnet-5-5 | high | Writing the product itself (content learners read). Volume work behind a judge and deterministic checks. |
| `build` | claude-sonnet-5-5 | medium | Code, UX, docs, analysis and calibration: volume work verified afterwards by QA, validators or a judge. |
| `mechanical` | claude-haiku-5-5 | — | Running scripts, packaging, releasing and test execution, where scripts decide pass or fail. |
| `dispatch` | claude-haiku-5-5 | — | Slash commands: they hand work to a pinned agent and relay its report. |

## Rules

1. **Pins win.** Never pass `model` on an Agent call; a call-time model
   overrides the agent's pin.
2. **Escalate, don't raise the default.** A step that fails the same gate twice
   is re-run once on the next tier up (haiku → sonnet → opus), and the lead records
   it. Repeated escalation of one agent is evidence to change its tier.
3. **Commands dispatch cheaply.** Commands run on the `dispatch` tier: they hand
   work to a pinned agent and relay its report.
4. **Scripts before judges.** Validators and hooks catch rule breaks for free;
   a judge only sees work the scripts already pass.
5. **Changing a pin.** For one agent: set `tier:` (or `effort:`/`maxTurns:`) in
   its `kit/agents/<name>.md` with the evidence in the commit message, then run
   `npm run kit`. For a model ID or a tier: change `tiers.json` in
   ajch_agent_framework, release a version, and re-render every vertical.
6. **Session model.** Work typed outside a command runs on the session's model.
   Use `/model sonnet` for day-to-day work; keep Opus for planning sessions.
